body.description: The one place to install, upgrade and remove applications in this organisation.

permissions.label: Manage App Store

props.title: App Store
props.text: Every application this organisation has published. Install an application to make it available here, or upgrade one to its latest version. Select an application to see what its latest version changes.

flows.description: Removes an installed ordinary application after confirming the retained records and withdrawn access.

literal.value: platform.review_application_removal

Its pages and launcher entry will be removed from this organisation. Its application roles and existing assignments will stop granting access. Records and storage are kept, along with published definitions, so the app can be reinstalled from the App Store. Reinstalling requires accepting roles and assigning access again.
